verdict.rationale: Slate's docs describe a per-user `/workspace` manager for adding/removing local directories the agent can access, but there is no evidence of a shared, multi-user workspace, team-wide knowledge base, or 'source of truth' aggregation feature for an engineering team. Missing for 10: any mention of team/shared workspaces, multi-user access controls, or docs+repo aggregation as a collaborative source of truth.
